info.name: Sanad Admin — Community moderation
info.description: Content moderation for Community posts. Requires a normal JWT with ContentAdmin or SuperAdmin role. Run only against disposable fixtures.

item.name: Publish pending post
item.description: ContentAdmin or SuperAdmin only. Returns 204 and makes the post visible to authenticated Community reads. Unknown or invalid-state posts return the standard problem response.

item.name: Reject pending post
item.description: ContentAdmin or SuperAdmin only. Returns 204. reasonCode is CommunityGuidelines|Spam|Duplicate|UnsafeContent|Other; Other requires a note. Notes are trimmed plain text up to 1000 characters. Rejection stores moderator and UTC decision time; pending/rejected posts remain hidden from the public Community feed.

item.name: List categories (admin)
item.description: ContentAdmin or SuperAdmin only. All categories including inactive, with isActive and timestamps.

item.name: Create category
item.description: ContentAdmin or SuperAdmin only. Returns 201 with the created item. Names are required (1–200 chars); invalid names return 400 Community.Category.Invalid. Capture the returned id as categoryId.

item.name: Update category
item.description: Renames and toggles isActive. Returns 200 with the updated item. Unknown ids return 404 Community.CategoryNotFound.

item.name: Delete category
item.description: Hard delete. Returns 204. Unknown ids return 404 Community.CategoryNotFound; categories referenced by posts return 409 Community.CategoryInUse.

item.name: Community moderation queue
item.description: ContentAdmin or SuperAdmin only. Paged queue with optional status/reportStatus/search filters and query-derived counters. Page size defaults to 25 and is capped at 100. Items include author ID and display names, never contact details.

item.name: Community moderation post detail
item.description: Returns post detail, retained reports, and chronological publish/rejection history. Author email and phone are not included. Unknown posts return 404.

item.name: Resolve Community report
item.description: resolution is ActionTaken or Dismissed; note is optional up to 1000 characters. Resolution records moderator/time but does not itself reject a post or restrict its author. Unknown report returns 404; already resolved returns 409.

item.name: Restrict Community author
item.description: Community-only write restriction. duration is Hours24|Days7|Days30; reasonCode is CommunityGuidelines|Spam|Duplicate|UnsafeContent|Other. Other requires a note. Blocks new posts/comments/replies only and does not change Identity state.

item.name: Revoke Community restriction
item.description: Ends a restriction early while retaining its original action and recording moderator, UTC time, and required reason. Unknown id returns 404; already revoked returns 409.
